description: Set the loaf against the board and said the pot was not short.
name: Alse Pinder

description: Named the penny and the thumb, and told Verbeke to eat.
name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

description: Named Norwich, and said nothing further.
name: Gillis Verbeke

description: Prayed for the dearth and for a quiet town.
name: Master Josias Thwaite
